title: Compile->declare->evaluate->publish sequence
statement: Implementations shall enforce the compile/dependency/evaluate/publish sequence with explicit state-transition checks and deterministic transition diagnostics.
notes: State transitions must not be implicit side effects.

title: Capability-gating enforcement
statement: Evaluation shall only observe FEC facilities declared by the compiled expression and enabled by profile capability policy.
notes: Violation outcomes must be deterministic and traceable.

title: Dependency-token lifecycle
statement: Dependency tokens shall be versioned, replaced deterministically on dependency declaration updates, and retired without hidden reuse.
notes: Token invalidation/rebind events must be observable in replay artifacts.

title: Error and violation mapping policy
statement: Compile/dependency/evaluation violations shall map to stable error classes and publication outcomes without ambiguous host-specific fallthrough.
notes: Error-class mapping tables must be version-scoped and replay-checked.
